text: 8月26日，财政部在安徽合肥举行财政科学管理研讨交流，深入学习领会习近平总书记关于财政工作的重要指示批示精神，贯彻落实财政科学管理试点座谈会精神，研究部署深入推进财政科学管理工作。财政部党组书记、部长蓝佛安出席并讲话。 会议认为，加强财政科学管理是党中央交给财政部门的一项重要政治任务，是提升财政治理效能、为中国式现代化提供更好保障的关键举措。2025年启动试点以来，财政科学管理工作取得阶段性成效。一是系统化管理能力大大增强。既抓预算统筹、收入划分、零基预算，又解决钱用得怎么样、怎样用得更好，把管理向前端延伸、向末梢压实。二是精细化管理导向更加鲜明。把精打
text_en: On August 26, the Ministry of Finance held a fiscal scientific management seminar in Hefei, Anhui, to deeply study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on fiscal work, implement the spirit of the pilot symposium on fiscal scientific management, and study and deploy advancing fiscal scientific management. Finance Minister Lan Fo'an attended and spoke. The meeting held that strengthening fiscal scientific management is an important political task assigned to fiscal departments by the Party Central Committee, and a key measure to enhance fiscal governance efficiency and better safeguard Chinese modernization. Since the pilot started in 2025, fiscal scientific management has achieved phased results. First, systematic management capabilities have been greatly strengthened, addressing budget coordination, revenue sharing, zero-based budgeting, and solving how funds are used and how to use them better, extending management to the front end and pushing it to the grassroots.
